messages.text: The full local `tests/cmd` set now passes live differential comparison at 67/67 after preserving caller-visible recursive path spelling. The source’s larger generated suites depend on Unix-only fixture creation (`sudo`, device nodes, ownership, permissions) and the required `tests/test_dir` directories are absent on this Windows workspace, so I’m now adding the remaining runnable stdin/mixed-error boundaries and validating the built `./executable` itself rather than only its source file.

commands.preview: Get-ChildItem rust-reference/tests/ptests -Filter *.toml | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object { $_.Name; Get-Content -Raw $_.FullName }; Get-Content -Raw rust-reference/powertest.yaml
